name: odorant binding protein 2B

function.text: OBP2B is the approved symbol for odorant binding protein 2B. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in odorant binding; small molecule binding; chemosensory behavior.

germline.text: No conflict-free strong or definitive constitutional disease relationship met the source-selection criteria for this draft; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Head and neck squamous cell carcinoma; Lung adenocarcinoma; Medulloblastoma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Historical hotspot cohort observation; individual-allele significance and tumor-specific oncogenicity require review.
